patches.summary: auth login persists browser cookies via Config.SaveCookies (writes the `cookies` TOML field) instead of SaveTokens (which wrote access_token).
patches.reason: The novel internal/svc client reads cfg.AnkiwebCookies (the `cookies` TOML key); storing cookies in access_token left that field empty after restart, so every cookie-authenticated svc endpoint returned 401/403 while auth status falsely reported Authenticated.
patches.validated_outcome: go build, go vet, and gofmt clean. SaveCookies also clears the bearer slots so AuthHeader() no longer masks an empty-cookie state.

patches.summary: Prefer Chrome profiles with the required auth cookies during browser-cookie login (resolveChromeProfile / discoverChromeProfiles).
patches.reason: Profile auto-detection previously ranked profiles only by total target-domain cookie count and skipped explicit Default-profile pycookiecheat paths, which could choose a profile with guest or challenge cookies instead of the authenticated session.

patches.summary: Standalone pycookiecheat installs remain profile-aware during browser-cookie login (cookieToolSupportsProfiles).
patches.reason: Users commonly install pycookiecheat as a uv tool or console script, which is not importable from the ambient python3. Falling through to Default-only cookie readers makes authenticated sessions in non-default Chrome profiles look missing.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passed from this CLI directory during the sweep.
